items.title: LoveCraftian
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: From the depths of dusty haunts and terrible secrets. These 10 spooky, Lovecraft-inspired skins emerge to share with you tales of gothic horror, mystery, and fantasy. Monsters include Cthulhu, Nyarlathotep, Hastur, Yog-Sothoth and more!

items.title: Onesie Sea Monsters
items.creator: Black Arts Studios
items.description:
Dive in with these cute sea monster onesies! Life is better underwater anyway, might as well swim in style! be the cutest in the ocean with these 14 skins!

+ Includes 14 skins
+ By: Black Arts Studios

items.title: Space Crash Survival
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Your spaceship crashed on a planet after being sabotaged. Survive hordes of aliens in this extreme environment. Scavenge loot, dive in dungeons, and take on this epic adventure! - Will you become the hunter or stay hunted? -

+ 5 different ALIENS
+ Skins: 8x Astronauts, 2x IMPOSTERS
+ The new SKYBLOCK experience
+ Custom QUEST books

! Play solo or roleplay with the squad

items.title: Valentine Demons
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Valentine's Day demons walk among us, and they are looking for a soul mate.
It is not an everyday event, and to find yours is not an easy task.
Are you up for the job? Make this day a day to remember and become one of the Valentine's Day demons!

+ 1 free demon girl.
+ 1 free demon angel.
+ 8 epic valentine demons!

items.title: Awkward Turtles
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: Thanks for coming! This meetup is for shy, introverted turtles who want to get out of their shell. Here’s your nametag, don’t forget to write down your hobbies like stamp collecting, coin collecting, kitty collecting, or taxidermy. Rita will talk about her cats all night and Sheldon mods video games. Take these complimentary 8 turtleneck skins to carry home on your back!

items.title: Hospital Life
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: Is there a doctor in the house? Doctors, nurses, orderlies, all manner of healers are here for your every medical need. Be on the front lines of medicine, treating all those who need a helping hand! Take a look at these twelve high-quality skins!

items.title: Little Cartoons
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: These colorful characters are as cute as can be! Take a look at these adorable skins, showing off their fashionable-yet-silly sense of humor. These ten little cartoon characters are ready for fun and adventure! Check out these high-quality skins!

items.title: Pests
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: If you go down to the woods today, you're in for a big surprise. The pests are out and chasing your picnic away. Disguise as a tree or be a funky bee for today is the day the pests come out to play!

items.title: Color Dots
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Are you missing some joy in your life? Perhaps you need a splash of color in your life? Well, you've come to the right place! Enjoy these mega colorful skins to your hearts content. Both with face and without included for any situation. Now get out there and color the world! 

- 42 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: GALAXY
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
GALAXY is a way to show off your love for the galactic universe. Choose between any of these awesome galaxy themed skins. These galaxy themed outfits will look perfect for your next PvP or PvE Minecraft adventure.

+ Includes 10 GALAXY skins
+ Galactic skin outfits
+ Perfect for anyone who loves space

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Skyblock
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Skyblock!

items.title: Actor Dreams
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Roll out the red carpet! Get the cameras ready! With these skins you’ll be showing off your style to all your fans! Enjoy the spotlight! Includes 2 free skins.

items.title: Chrome Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Chrome teens time! Everyones got a little chrome plating to spice up their fashion! Roleplay away with fresh new colors! Anime themed color fashion is here and ready to stay! Get your Chrome Teen skin today!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ 1 free skin!
+ By 4theSenpai

items.title: Cyber Demons
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Being a cyber demon is very fun! Put on these outfits and look like a demon from the future! Try them on and have fun like they do in the cyber world!

+ 12 skins
+ By Dalibu Studios

items.title: Frozen Temple
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The freezing winter has come to this town. Make the temple and town of your dreams in this frozen land. Explore dungeons hidden around the town and improve your armor. Finally you'll solve the mystery of the Frozen Temple!

-By Withercore Studios

items.title: Istanbul Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Show off your elegant style as the moon rises over the city. Let's get to Istanbul and twinkle like a star when you're crossing the streets and avenues.

- 14 skins
- By Withercore Studios

items.title: Try Hard Teens
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These fashionable high school teens are perfect for roleplay and just hanging out. 
* 33 cool characters!

items.title: Royalty Among Us
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
The next time your build a medieval city or castle make sure to equip one of these awesome royal characters! 
* 33 HD skins!

items.title: Mob and Block Agents
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Roleplay as a mob in the city, millionaire, secret agent or undercover spy in your minecraft world. Or throw a mob party or suss out a situation in style. These mobs in suits are dressed for any black suit occasion! Find your favorite mob among these 15 secret agents.

- 15 mob skins
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Pastel Monsters
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Scare your friends while still looking cute? Do that and more with these pastel monsters in your world today!
- 10 unique skins
- by Billii

items.title: Cute Mashup Pack
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Transform your favorite Minecraft world into a wonderful miniature land using this super cute, brightly colored 8x8 resource pack.

Cute 8x8 textures
Custom models
8 skins included
By Voxelblocks

items.title: Rich Base
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Practice your PvP skills, brew potions, create your own farm, and more in this luxurious survival base! Choose between 3 massive modern bedrooms, the pool, a movie room, and more to spend your free time. 

- 20+ rooms and 8 skins
- Perfect for survival
- Starting gear
- By PixelStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Advanced Creepers
items.creator: Enchanted
items.description:
The Advanced Creeper arena awaits you! Traverse unique terrains and fight against 7 custom creeper bosses in legendary battles! Conquer a range of exclusive bosses from the Magma Creeper to the Ender Creeper. Will you rise to the challenge and take on each boss?
- 7 unique creeper bosses
- 1 free skin
- Themed terrain to explore
- By Enchanted

items.title: CRAFTABLE SKYBLOCK!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
Craftable Skyblock Islands! This map combines the best things Minecraft has to offer, crafting and skyblock! Craft your way through lots of different skyblock islands with each island granting you new resources and allowing you to craft other islands!

- Skyblock with a twist!
- 14 Different custom craftable skyblock islands!
- Play alone or with friends!
